# Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7

Matching frontend for **Navimower 0.5.0-beta8**.

## Consistent live trail width

Live trail rendering now uses non-scaling SVG strokes consistently in both
Single and Multi mower views.

- semantic live cutting;
- prepared live route;
- raw/prepared MQTT live tail;
- Multi mower live fallbacks.

This keeps the trail readable when zoomed out without making it visually too
thick when the user zooms in.

## Current-cycle white-gap repair

The white holes seen in completed H-series mowing coverage were not created by
the browser. Diagnostics showed 171 backend gap-guard breaks while both zone
artifacts were healthy and complete. The matching integration 0.5.0-beta8
migrates that old fixed 5 m guard to an adaptive backend guard and rebuilds the
affected current-cycle artifacts. The card then renders the repaired resource
normally.

Use the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta8
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7
